admission_rule: Once/stage after expansion; frozen eval/no-grad supplied-label CE; keep all new-global classes or local groups <20; otherwise ceil(3*n/4); ties immutable ID; nonfinite fails
aggregation: FP32 increasing client ID; weight distinct admitted current count / sum active counts; zero-current clients inactive; final shared model applies to all five clients
authorization: User: adopt the data amendments, resolve the taxonomy, and build one correct reference trajectory before launching the GPU grid.
checkpoint: Pickle-free typed NPZ + decimal-string 128-bit PCG64 state; atomic round transaction and hash commit marker; interrupted rounds rollback all clients; resume exact identity only

data.attempted_rule: Attempted Category != -1 maps to Benign; metadata is never a predictor
data.benign_selection: Seed-2027 one-pass whole cross-stage benign-bundle heuristic toward 3500/stage; attacks retained independently; excluded benign remains train-reserved
data.calibration: Monday-only source-valid benign; frozen min/max; zero range denominator 1; FP32; signed zero normalized; no clipping/refit
data.clock: Authors ISO UTC microseconds as supplied
data.component_id: Minimum immutable row ID of full provenance component including excluded members
data.graph: 120-second unordered-endpoint/protocol interval sessions + raw FP64/final FP32 exact-input links; excluded provenance bridges retained
data.ownership: Five clients; PCG64 SeedSequence([1,1,seed]); family Dirichlet(.5); normalized squared-error greedy; component-size descending/canonical-ID tie order; smallest-client exact ties
data.split: SGKF5 shuffle=True seed=2026; test=0 dev=1 train=2/3/4; sklearn 1.9.1 source pinned in split report

evaluation: Separate development-only evaluator; full active head first-maximum argmax, Benign slot 0; eligible macro bank separate from full-seen binary bank; fixed benign union and original-background/remapped-attempted descriptive rates

model.head_init: Xavier uniform gain=1; fan-out is new block row count; zero bias

replay.insertion: Algorithm R after optimizer update; independent PCG64 draw/insert streams
replay.objective: Separate current CE + lambda_y replay CE in train mode + lambda_z mean(per-record width-normalized eval-mode logit MSE with gradients); mask before square
replay.proposal_pass: Round 1 epoch 1 only; one proposal per distinct admitted current record
replay.sampling: Uniform without replacement min(128,occupancy), independent of current final-batch size
replay.teacher: Pre-update eval/no-grad logits; store observed width

rng: PCG64 SeedSequence([1,namespace,seed,*scope]); namespace IDs 1 ownership,4 encoder,5 head(stage),6 order(client,stage,round,epoch),7 replay draw(client),8 replay insert(client),10 persistent client dropout; torch seeds derived uniformly below 2^63
settings_status: Untuned implementation reference fixed before its first model outcome; not a selected final synchronization or hyperparameter setting

taxonomy.append_rule: Benign slot 0; sorted supplied current-stage source codes not already registered; no future logits
taxonomy.claim: New annotated-class acquisition in a historical capture; source scenario distinctions do not establish novel techniques, zero-day detection or host/campaign independence
taxonomy.rare_policy: Train supported classes and retain all active logits; eligibility requires 50 rows and 5 components in each role; no heldout Heartbleed positives; E3 only Infiltration - Portscan is eligible
